rtl_topology.axi_dynclk_vhd_lines_198_202: BUFIO drives PXL_CLK_5X_O directly from bufio_in.

static_clock_analysis.assessment: The XDC declares PixelClk as the master and SerialClk as a x5 descendant, while the reference BD connects these signals to distinct dynamic-clock outputs and the RTL shows two branches from the common bufio_in: BUFIO directly to the 5x output and BUFR divide-by-5 to the pixel output. Available static evidence does not show a logical PixelClk-to-SerialClk path. Removing the unsupported direction is preferred over inventing the reverse sibling-clock hierarchy; this does not establish the complete or correct timing model for the design.

candidate_patch.change: Remove only the single create_generated_clock declaration from the copied RGB2DVI clock XDC; retain the header and add no reverse generated-clock declaration.
